blocks.text: South Slope Houses: the housing stock

items.t: The stock is detached houses on the slope streets between Rumble Street and Marine Drive, with the Royal Oak Station area at the slope's northern half rather than inside the house blocks themselves.

blocks.text: South Slope Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The slope's creeks are boundary markers as much as water features: they divide the plan area's internal streets between Rumble Street and Marine Drive.
Rumble Street is the top of the hill and Marine Drive the bottom, so a South Slope address's position on the hill is read off those two streets.

blocks.text: South Slope Houses: getting around

items.t: Rumble Street runs the top of the hill and Marine Drive the bottom, with Royal Oak Avenue and Gilley Avenue in the plan's street frame, and the Royal Oak Station area at the slope's northern half.
Suncrest, the all-detached pocket to the west, shares the Rumble Street spine and the Lewarne Park seam on Macpherson Avenue at Rumble Street.

blocks.text: South Slope Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check for a watercourse setback if the lot sits near Frogger's Creek, Gray Creek, John Matthews Creek or Byrne Creek, since all four cross the plan area.
Confirm whether the lot falls in the Royal Oak Station Area District or on the slope below it, because the plan rules differ between the two.

blocks.text: Jared's take on South Slope

Burnaby’s south-facing hill is South Slope, with houses running from Rumble Street down toward Marine Drive across the Frogger’s Creek and Byrne Creek ravines. It’s the pick for buyers who want a slope on the Royal Oak side of the city.

South Slope home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

37 houses sold in South Slope with a median price of $1,860,000 (the middle half sold between $1,700,000 and $2,325,000), taking a median of 30 days to sell at 94.8% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $610 per square foot, a median year built of 1979 and a median lot of 7,315 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in South Slope?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 33 houses listed in South Slope. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is South Slope a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in South Slope had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in South Slope from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 22 houses sold in South Slope over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in South Slope?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: Does the Royal Oak Community Plan cover my South Slope lot?
faq.a: It covers the slope's northern half and the Royal Oak Station area, with the Station Area District drawn between Nelson Avenue, MacPherson Avenue, Imperial Street and Rumble Street and the slope streets running down to Marine Drive, so check the plan map for the lot's position before assuming station-area rules apply.

faq.q: Do creeks affect South Slope lots?
faq.a: Four named creeks cross the plan area between Rumble Street and Marine Drive — Frogger's Creek, Gray Creek, John Matthews Creek and Byrne Creek — so a lot near one of them needs a watercourse setback check with the City, since the creeks are the slope's internal boundaries.

faq.q: What did houses in South Slope sell for?
faq.a: 37 houses sold in South Slope between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,860,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in South Slope?
faq.a: The median was 30 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.8% of the last list price (5% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
